## Source: amazon-inspector (02d1a0fd24e2ff483690bd10527de9cc0eef12b8eca08487707a66725117d58b)
Review of flintqueue 0.1.0 on PyPI did not surface install-time or import-time behavior that targets the installer. No lifecycle hook network I/O, no credential or home-directory scanning, no outbound beacons to third-party endpoints, and no fetch-and-execute dropper were observed in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (603240baf11c5a5c77d3a008dcfad49b31026bca034692ecae35780a6f0e6855)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
